{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for LOYAL customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check if any QA orders are in this group
qa_in_loyal_completed = loyal_completed[loyal_completed['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f'QA orders in LOYAL completed group: {len(qa_in_loyal_completed)}')

# Check if any refunded orders are in this group
refunded_in_loyal_completed = loyal_completed[loyal_completed['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f'Refunded orders in LOYAL completed group: {len(refunded_in_loyal_completed)}')

# Compute mean revenue
total_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].sum()
num_orders = len(loyal_completed)
mean_revenue = total_revenue / num_orders

print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders from LOYAL customers: {mean_revenue}')

# Output for submission
mean_revenue"}
